messages.content: Hey Mel! Good to see you How been?
Hey Caroline Good to see you swamped kids work. What's up with you? Anything new?
went to LGBTQ support group yesterday it was so powerful.
Wow, that's cool, Caroline! What happened so awesome? hear any inspiring stories?
transgender stories were inspiring! I was happy and thankful for all support. Image: a photo of a dog walking past a wall with a painting of a woman
Wow, love painting! cool you found helpful group. What's it done for you?
support group made me feel accepted given courage to embrace myself.
That's cool. You've guts. What now?
Gonna continue my edu check out career options, pretty exciting!
Wow, Caroline! What jobs you thinkin' of? Anything stands out?
keen on counseling working in mental health - love to support with similar issues.
You'd be great counselor! Your empathy understanding help people you work with. By way, take a look at this. Image: a photo of a painting of a sunset over a lake
Thanks, Melanie!'s really sweet. your own painting?
, painted lake sunrise last year! It's special to me.
Wow, Melanie! colors blend nicely. Painting looks great outlet for expressing yourself.
Thanks, Caroline! Painting's fun way to express feelings get creative.'s great way to relax after long day.
agree, Mel. Relaxing expressing ourselves is key. I'm off to go do research.
Yep, Caroline. Taking care of ourselves vital. I'm off swimming with kids. Talk you soon!
Hey Caroline, since last chatted, I've had lot of things happening to. ran charity race for mental health last Saturday – rewarding. made me think about taking care of our minds.
charity race sounds great, Mel! Making difference raising awareness for mental health super rewarding -'m proud of you for taking part!
Thanks, Caroline! event thought-provoking.'m starting to realize self-care important It's a journey for me, but when I look after myself,'m able to better look after my family.
agree, Melanie. Taking care of ourselves is important - even if not always easy. Great you're prioritizing self-care.
Yeah, it's tough. I'm carving out me-time each day - running, reading playing violin - refreshes me helps stay present for my fam!
That's great, Mel! Taking time for yourself important. You're doing awesome job looking after yourself family!
Thanks, Caroline. still work in progress but I doing my best. kids excited about summer break! thinking about going camping next month. Any fun plans for summer?
Researching adoption agencies — a dream to have a family give loving home to kids need it.
Wow, Caroline! awesome! Taking in kids in need - you're so kind. Your future family lucky to have you!

Thanks, Mel! goal is to give kids a loving home.'m grateful for support from friends mentors. Now hard work starts to turn my dream into reality. here's one of adoption agencies I'm looking into. It's a lot to take in, but'm feeling hopeful and optimistic. Image: a photography of a sign for a new arrival and an information and domestic building
Wow agency looks great! What made pick it?
chose them they help LGBTQ+ folks with adoption Their inclusivity support spoke to me.
That's great, Caroline! Loving inclusivity support. Anything excited for in adoption process?
'm thrilled to make a family for kids need one. It'll tough as single parent, but'm up for challenge!
You're doing something amazing! Creating family for kids lovely. You'll be awesome mom! Good luck!
Thanks, Melanie! Your kind words mean a lot. I'll do best to make kids have safe loving home.
No doubts, Caroline. You have caring heart - they'll get love stability they need! Excited for new chapter!

Hey Melanie! How's it going? wanted to tell my school event last week. It was awesome! talked my transgender journey encouraged students get involved LGBTQ community. great to see their reactions. made me reflect on how far I've come since started transitioning three years ago.

Hey Caroline! Great to hear from you. your event was amazing! proud of you for spreading awareness getting others involved in LGBTQ community. You've come long way since transition keep inspiring people with your strength courage!

Thanks, Mel! Your backing means a lot. I felt super powerful giving my talk. shared my own journey, struggles I've developed since coming out. wonderful to see how audience related to I said it inspired them to be better allies. Conversations about gender identity and inclusion are necessary I'm thankful for to give a voice to the trans community.

Wow, Caroline, you're doing awesome job inspiring others with your journey. great to be part of it see you positively affecting many. Talking inclusivity acceptance is crucial, you're brave to speak up for trans community. Keep up great work!

Thanks Mel! Your kind words mean a lot. Sharing experiences isn't always easy, but feel's important to help promote understanding acceptance. I've been blessed with love support throughout journey, want to pass it on to others By sharing stories can build strong, supportive community of hope.

Yeah, Caroline! takes courage to talk about our own stories But in vulnerable moments we bond understand each other. We all have different paths but if we share them show people they're not alone. Our stories be inspiring encouraging to others facing same challenges. Thank you for using your voice to create love, acceptance hope. You're doing amazing!

Your words mean a lot to. I'm grateful for chance to share my story give others hope. We all have unique paths working together can build more inclusive understanding world. I'm to keep using my voice to make change lift others up you're part of that!
Thanks, Caroline, for letting me join your journey. proud to be part of difference you making. Let's keep motivating helping each other we journey through life. make real impact together!
Yeah Mel,'s spread love understanding! Thanks for support encouragement. tackle life's challenges together! We got this!
Yes, Caroline! We can do it Your courage inspiring want be couragous for family they motivate me give love. What motivates you?
Thanks, Mel! My friends, family mentors are my rocks – they motivate me give strength to push on. Here's pic from met up last week! Image: a photo of a family posing for a picture in a yard
Wow, that photo is great! How long had great support system?

Yeah, I'm lucky to have them. They've been there through everything, known friends for 4 years, since moved from home country. Their love and help important especially after tough breakup.'m super thankful. Who supports you, Mel?
lucky to have husband kids; they keep me motivated. Image: a photo of a man and a little girl standing in front of a waterfall
Wow, what amazing family pic! How long been married?
5 years! Time flies feels like yesterday put dress on Thanks, Caroline! Image: a photo of a bride in a wedding dress holding a bouquet
Congrats, Melanie! You both looked great wedding day Wishing many happy years together!
Thanks, Caroline! Appreciate kind words. Looking forward to more happy years. family moments make worth it. Image: a photo of a man and woman sitting on a blanket eating food
you had great day! How was it? You all look happy!
fun! We played games ate good food hung out together. Family moments make life awesome.
Sounds great, Mel! Glad had great time. Cherish moments - they're best!
Absolutely, Caroline! I cherish time with family. when feel alive happy.
100% agree, Mel. Hanging with loved ones is amazing brings happiness. moments make me thankful. Family is everything.
Hey Melanie Long time no talk A lot going on in my life look at this. Image: a photo of a person holding a necklace with a cross and a heart
Hey, Caroline! Nice to hear from you! Love necklace special meaning?

Thanks, Melanie! This necklace super special to me - a gift from my grandma in my home country, Sweden. She gave it to me when I was young, stands for love, faith strength's reminder of my roots love and support from my family.
That's gorgeous, Caroline! awesome what items mean much to us, right? any other objects you treasure, like necklace? Image: a photo of a stack of bowls with different designs on them
Yep, Melanie! I've got other stuff sentimental value like my hand-painted bowl. friend made it for my 18th birthday ten years ago. pattern colors awesome reminds me of art self-expression.
sounds great, Caroline! It's awesome having stuff around make us think of good connections and times., I took my fam camping in mountains last week - nice time together!
Sounds great, Mel made new family mems How was it? Anything fun?

awesome time, Caroline! We explored nature, roasted marshmallows around campfire even went on a hike. view from top amazing! 2 younger kids love nature. special having these moments together as a family - I'll never forget it!
That's awesome, Melanie! Family moments like special. Glad y'all had a great time.
Thanks Caroline! Family time matters What's up you lately?
Lately, I've looking into counseling mental health as a career. want to help people gone through same things as me. Image: a photo of a book shelf with many books on it
Sounds great! What kind counseling mental health services want to persue?

I'm still figuring out details, thinking of working with trans people helping them accept themselves supporting their mental health. Last Friday went to LGBTQ+ counseling workshop enlightening. talked about different therapeutic methods how to best work with trans people. Seeing passionate these pros about making safe space for people like me was amazing.
Woah, Caroline, sounds you doing impressive work. inspiring see your dedication to helping others. What motivated to pursue counseling?

Thanks, Melanie. It mattered. My own journey support got made huge difference. Now I want to help people go through it too. saw counseling support groups improved my life started caring more about mental health understanding myself. Now passionate about creating safe, inviting place for people to grow.
Wow, Caroline! gained much from own experience. Your passion hard work to help others is awesome. Keep it up, making big impact!
Thanks Melanie! kind words mean lot
Congrats Caroline! Good on you for going after what care. Image: a photo of a book shelf filled with books in a room
Since we last spoke, big things happened. Last week I went to LGBTQ+ pride parade. Everyone was happy made me feel like I belonged. showed me our community grown, it was amazing!
Wow, Caroline, sounds like parade was awesome experience! great to see love and support for LGBTQ+ community. Congrats! Has this experience influenced your goals?
Thanks, Mel! motivated me for. Talking to community made me want to use my story to help others - still thinking counseling and mental health is way to go. super excited to give back.

Wow, Caroline! That's great! signed up for pottery class yesterday. It's like therapy for me, letting express myself get creative. found any activities make you feel same way? Image: a photo of a person holding a frisbee in their hand
Wow, Melanie! I getting creative learning piano. What made you try pottery?
I'm big fan of pottery - creativity and skill awesome. Plus, making it calming. Look at this! Image: a photo of a bowl with a black and white flower design
bowl gorgeous! black and white design looks fancy. Did you make it?
Thanks, Caroline! made this bowl in my class. took some work, but'm proud of it.
Nice job! You really put in work shows. Your creativity looks great!
Thanks, Caroline! Your kind words mean a lot. Pottery is huge part of my life not just hobby - helps express emotions. Clay is incredible, brings much joy!
Wow, Mel, I'm stoked for you art helping you express yourself bring joy! Keep it up!
Thanks, Caroline! excited see pottery takes me. Anything coming up looking forward to?
Thanks Mel! I going to transgender conference this month. excited to meet other people community learn more about advocacy. It's gonna be great!
Sounds awesome, Caroline! Have great time learn lot. Have fun!
Cool thanks Mel! Can't wait keep posted. Bye!
Bye Caroline! Can't wait to hear. Have fun stay safe!
Hey Mel Long time no talk Lots going on since then
Caroline Missed you Anything new? Spill beans!
Since last chat, looking into counseling mental health work more. passionate about helping people making positive impact. It's tough, but rewarding too. Anything new happening with you?

That's awesome, Caroline! Congrats on following your dreams. Yesterday took kids to museum - cool spending time with them seeing their eyes light up! Image: a photography of two children playing in a water play area
Melanie,'s great pic! must have been awesome. What were they stoked about?
They stoked for dinosaur exhibit! They love learning about animals bones were cool. reminds me why I love being a mom.
Being a mom is awesome.'m creating library for when have kids. looking forward to reading to them opening up their minds. Image: a photo of a bookcase filled with books and toys
Sounds great! What kind books in your library?
I've got lots of kids' books- classics, stories from different cultures, educational books,. What's favorite book remember from childhood?
loved reading "Charlotte's Web" as a kid. cool seeing how friendship and compassion can make difference. Image: a photo of a book cover with a picture of a girl and a cat

Wow, that's great! shows important friendship compassion. It's made me appreciate how lucky I to have friends and family helping with my transition. They make difference. We had a picnic last week! Image: a photo of a group of women sitting on a blanket in a park
's gorgeous photo, Caroline! Wow, love around you is awesome. How your friends and fam helping you with your transition?
Thanks, Melanie! This support network amazing. They've been there for me every step giving me love, guidance acceptance. couldn't have done it without them.
Wow, Caroline!'s great you have people support you, really awesome!
I'm lucky to have great support system around me. Their love encouragement helped me accept grow into my true self. They've instrumental in my transition.
Glad you support, Caroline! Unconditional love important. Here pic of my family camping at beach. We love it, brings us closer! Image: a photo of a family sitting around a campfire on the beach

Hey Mel, great to chat with you again! much happened since we last spoke - I went to LGBTQ conference two days ago it was really special. got chance to meet and connect with people gone through similar journeys. welcoming environment felt accepted.'m thankful for this amazing community - it's shown me how important it to fight for trans rights spread awareness.
Wow, Caroline, sounds awesome! glad you felt accepted supported. Events like these great for reminding us how strong community be!
Yeah, it's true! Having people back you makes huge difference. great to see far LGBTQ rights come, but still plenty of progress to be made. I wanna help make difference.
Wow, Caroline. We've come so far more to do. Your drive to help awesome! plan to pitch in?
Thanks, Mell! still looking into counseling mental health jobs. important to people have someone to talk to, want to help make that happen.
Wow, Caroline! You're inspiring for wanting help others mental health. What's pushing you to keep going forward?

struggled with mental health, support got was helpful. made me realize how important it for others to have support system. started looking into counseling mental health career options, so could help other people on their own journeys like I was helped.

Caroline, glad you got support! Your experience brought you to where you need to be. You're gonna make huge difference! book read last year reminds me to pursue dreams, like you doing!🌟 Image: a photography of a book cover with a gold coin on it

Thanks, Mel! Seeing this pic made me appreciate my love of reading more. Books guide motivate help discover who I am. They're huge part of my journey, this one's reminding me to keep going never give up!
Wow, Caroline! Books have awesome power! Which one your favorite guide?

loved "Becoming Nicole" by Amy Ellis Nutt. It's real inspiring true story about trans girl her family. made me feel connected gave hope for my own path. Highly recommend it for sure! Image: a photo of a dog sitting in a boat on the water
sounds awesome! What take away from it use in your life?
taught me self-acceptance how to find support. showed me tough times don't last - hope and love exist. Pets bring much joy too,.
Caroline, lessons great - self-acceptance finding support key. Plus pets awesome for joy comfort, can't agree more! Image: a photography of two little girls sitting on the steps with a dog
That's so nice! What pet have?
We've got a pup and kitty. That's dog, here's our cat! They brighten our day make us smile. Image: a photo of a cat laying on the floor with its head on the floor
Ah, they're adorable! What their names? Pets bring much joy to us!
Luna and Oliver! They so sweet and playful - liven up house! Just got new shoes, too! Image: a photo of a person wearing pink sneakers on a white rug
Love purple color! walking or running?
Thanks, Caroline! These for running. Been running longer since last chat great way to destress clear mind. Image: a photo of a pair of pink sneakers in a box
Wow What got into running?
've been running farther to de-stress, great for my headspace.
Cool, Melanie! Running boost mood. Keep it up!
Thanks, Caroline! great for mental health. I'm gonna keep it up.
Awesome, Melanie! Mental health's priority, you take care of yourself.
Caroline, thanks! Mental health important to me, it's made improvement!
Glad it helped Melanie!
Hey Mel, what's up? busy week since talked.

Hey Caroline, it's super busy here. much since we talked! Last Fri took kids to pottery workshop. We made our own pots, was fun and therapeutic! Image: a photography of a group of children making clay sculptures in a classroom
Wow, Mel! Sounds you kids had blast. How'd they like it?
kids loved it! excited to get hands dirty make something with clay. special to watch their creativity and imagination come to life, they made this! Image: a photo of a cup with a dog face on it
Aww, that's so sweet! cup cute. awesome to see kids show personalities through art. What other creative projects you do with them, besides pottery?
love painting together lately especially nature-inspired ones. latest work from last weekend. Image: a photo of a painting of a sunset with a palm tree
Wow Mel, that painting's amazing! colors bold highlights the beauty of nature. Y'all work on it together?

Thanks, Caroline! We both helped with painting - great bonding chatting about nature. found these lovely flowers. Appreciating small things in life, too. Image: a photo of a field of purple flowers with green leaves

photo stunning! glad you bonded over love of nature. Last Friday went to council meeting for adoption. inspiring and emotional - many people wanted to create loving homes for children in need. made me more determined to adopt.
Wow, Caroline, way to go! future fam get kick having you. What do you think of these? Image: a photo of a blue vase with a bouquet of sunflowers and roses
Thanks Melanie - love blue vase pic! Blue's my fave makes me feel relaxed. Sunflowers mean warmth happiness? roses stand for love beauty? neat. What do flowers mean to you?

Flowers bring joy. represent growth, beauty reminding us to appreciate small moments. important part of my wedding decor always remind me of that day. Image: a photo of a row of white chairs with flowers on them
must have been special at your wedding. wish known you back then!
amazing, Caroline. day full of love and joy. Everyone we love there to celebrate us - it really special. Image: a photo of a wedding ceremony in a greenhouse with people taking pictures
Wow, great day! Glad everyone could make it. your favorite part?
Marrying partner promising to be together forever was best part. Image: a photo of a man and woman standing on a beach
Wow, nice pic! You both looked amazing. special memory pride parade I went to few weeks ago. Image: a photo of a parade with people walking down the street
Wow, looks awesome! join in?
Yes, I did. It was amazing! felt accepted happy being around people who accepted celebrated me. It definitely top memory. Image: a photo of a group of people holding up signs and smiling
Wow, what experience! How make you feel?
I felt so proud and grateful - vibes were amazing comforting to know I'm not alone have great community around me. Image: a photo of a rainbow flag on a pole on a carpet
Wow, Caroline! That's huge! How did feel be around much love acceptance?
was awesome, Melanie! Being around people who embrace back me up beyond words. inspired me. Image: a photo of a group of people sitting on the ground with a dog
Wow, sounds awesome! Your friends community have your back. What's best part of it? Image: a photo of a girl sitting in a teepee with stuffed animals
Realizing I can be me without fear having courage to transition best part.'s freeing to express myself authentically have people back me up. Image: a photo of a teepee with a teddy bear and pillows
's awesome, Caro! You've found courage to be yourself - important for mental health finding peace. Image: a photo of a buddha statue and a candle on a table
Thanks, Melanie! long road proud of how far I've come. How're you doing finding peace?
getting there, Caroline. Creativity family keep at peace. Image: a photo of a man holding a frisbee in front of a frisbee golf basket
's awesome, Melanie! How your family supportive during your move?
My fam's been awesome - helped out showed lots love support.
Wow, Mel, family love support is best!

Yeah, Caroline, my family's great - their love support helped me through tough times awesome! We went on another camping trip in forest. Image: a photo of a man and two children sitting around a campfire
Awesome, Mel! Family support's huge. What else like doing together? Image: a photo of a family walking through a forest with a toddler
We enjoy hiking in mountains exploring forests.'s cool way to connect with nature each other.
Wow, Mel, sounds awesome! Exploring nature family time is special.
Yeah, Caroline, they're my fave memories. It brings us together happiness. Glad you're here to share it.
Thanks, Melanie! glad to have you friend share my journey. You're awesome!
Thanks, Caroline! Appreciate friendship. great to have supporter!
No worries, Mel! Your friendship means much to. Enjoy day!
Hey Caroline, hope all's good! had quiet weekend after went camping with fam two weekends ago great to unplug hang with kids. What've you been up to? Anything fun over weekend?
Hey Melanie! sounds great! Last weekend joined mentorship program for LGBTQ youth -'s rewarding to help community.
Wow, Caroline! great you're helping out. How's it going? Got any cool experiences share?
mentoring going great! I've met amazing young folks supported them along way.'s inspiring to see how resilient strong they are.
Wow, Caroline, sounds super rewarding! Young people's resilience amazing. Care share stories?
I mentor transgender teen like me. We've been working on building up confidence finding positive strategies, it's paying off! had great time at LGBT pride event last month.
Caroline awesome news you two getting along What was it like you both? Care fill me in?
pride event was awesome! encouraging to be surrounded by much love and acceptance. Image: a photo of a woman holding a rainbow umbrella in the air
Wow! What's best part you remember it?
Seeing my mentee's face light up when saw support was best! Such special moment.
Wow, Caroline! They must felt appreciated. awesome to see difference make in each other's lives. Any other exciting LGBTQ advocacy stuff coming?
Yay! Next month LGBTQ art show with my paintings can't wait!
Wow Caroline sounds awesome! Can't wait to see your art any previews? Image: a photo of a painting with a blue and yellow design
Check out painting art show! Hope you like it. Image: a photography of a painting of a tree with a bright sun in the background
Wow, Caroline, that painting is awesome! colors vivid the whole thing looks unified. What inspired you?
Thanks, Melanie! painted this after visited LGBTQ center. wanted to capture everyone's unity strength.
Wow, Caroline! It conveys unity strength - gorgeous piece! My kids and I finished another painting like last one.
Hey Melanie wanted say hi!
Caroline Good to talk again What's up? Anything new since last time?

Hey Mel! A lot's happened since we last chatted - I joined a new LGBTQ activist group last Tues.'m meeting many cool people passionate about rights community support.'m giving my voice making real difference, plus it's fulfilling in many ways. It's just great, you know?
That's awesome, Caroline! Glad to hear you found great group can have impact. it feels great to to speak your truth stand up for what's right. Want to tell me more about it?

Thanks, Melanie! awesome to have our own platform support others' rights. Our group, 'Connected LGBTQ Activists', made of all kinds of people investing in positive changes. We have regular meetings plan events campaigns to support each other.
Wow, Caroline your group sounds awesome! Supporting each other making good things happen inspiring! been part of any events or campaigns lately?

Last weekend our city held pride parade! many people marched through streets waving flags holding signs celebrating love and diversity. I missed it but powerful reminder we not alone in fight for equality inclusivity. Change is possible!
Wow, fantastic, Caroline! Bet atmosphere was incredible., we went to beach recently. It was awesome! kids had a blast. Image: a photo of three children playing on the beach with a kite
Sounds fun! What best part? you do it often with kids?

Seeing kids' faces happy at beach best! We don't go often, usually only once or twice a year those times always special to spend time together chill. Image: a photo of a sand castle on the beach with a blue sky
Sounds special, beach trips! have any other summer traditions do together? Create those memories!

We always look forward to family camping trip. roast marshmallows tell stories around campfire enjoy each other's company. It highlight of our summer! Image: a photo of a fire pit with a lot of fire and sparks
Wow, Mel,'s awesome! your best camping memory?

I'll always remember our camping trip last year saw Perseid meteor shower. amazing lying there watching sky light up with streaks of light. We all made wishes felt at one with universe. That's a memory I'll never forget. Image: a photo of a plane flying in the sky with a star filled sky
Cool What it look like?

sky was clear filled with stars, meteor shower was amazing - felt like we were part of something huge and awe-inspiring. Image: a photo of a plane flying in the sky with a trail of smoke coming out of it
Wow, Mel. must've breathtaking!
It was one of those moments felt tiny in awe of universe. Reminds me awesome life - many little moments like that. Image: a photo of a beach with footprints in the sand and a blue sky
That's great, Mel! What other good memories make you feel thankful for life?
I'll never forget day my youngest took her first steps. Seeing her wobble took initial steps put into perspective how fleeting life is how lucky I am to share these moments.
Aw, that's sweet, Mel! milestones great reminders of special our bonds. Image: a photo of a baby in a white crib with a blue blanket
Yeah, they sure are. special moments like these make me appreciate life lucky I to be with my family have our love. Image: a photography of a family standing on the beach at sunset
Wow, Melanie, beautiful moment! Lucky you to have awesome family!
Thanks, Caroline! I'm lucky to have my family; they bring joy love.

Hey Caroline! Last night amazing! We celebrated my daughter's birthday with concert surrounded by music, joy warm summer breeze. Seeing kids' smiles awesome,'m thankful for our special moments together.

Wow, sounds wonderful! Your love for kids awesome. What concert it? advocacy event cool experience - so much love and support, amazing! Image: a photo of a poster for a concert with a picture of a man
Thanks, Caroline! Matt Patterson, he talented! His voice songs amazing. What's up with you? Anything interesting going on?

Wow, Mel, glad you had a blast at concert. lot's happened since we talked. went to pride parade last Friday was awesome - much energy and love everywhere. made me proud reminded me important to keep standing up for equality.
Wow, that's awesome! How feel being part of community? Image: a photo of a band performing on stage with a sign that says all are welcome
inspiring, Mel! Check out crowd. People of all kinds celebrating love acceptance - pushed me to keep fighting for LGBTQ rights. Image: a photo of a group of people walking down a street with balloons

Wow, Caroline! sounds awesome. pic's from last night - looks everyone having a blast! Reminds me's important to cultivate loving accepting environment for our kids. How you stay inclusive in work as artist? Image: a photo of a group of people sitting on chairs watching a band

pic cool! Representing inclusivity diversity in my art important to me. I also use it to speak up for LGBTQ+ community push for acceptance.'s recent painting! Image: a photo of a painting with a painting brush and paint on it
Wow, that rocks!'s main idea your art?
My art about expressing my trans experience.'s my way showing my story helping people understand trans community. Image: a photo of a painting of a woman with a cow in her lap
Your art's amazing, Caroline. love you use it to tell stories teach people about trans folks.'d love to see another painting! Image: a photo of a person holding a purple bowl in their hand

Thanks, Melanie. one- 'Embracing Identity' about finding comfort love in being yourself. woman in painting stands for journey of acceptance. aim was to show warmth, love self-acceptance. Image: a photo of a painting of a woman with a red shirt
Wow, Caroline, that's gorgeous! love self-acceptance love theme. How does art help you self-discovery acceptance journey? Image: a photo of a woman is making a vase on a wheel
Art's allowed me to explore transition changing body. It great way to work through stuff I'm going through. love it teaches me to accept beauty of imperfections.

Wow, Caroline, that's so cool! Art can healing to connect with who you are.'s awesome beauty can found in the imperfections. We're all individual and wonderfully imperfect. Thanks for sharing it with!
Thanks, Melanie. means a lot share this you.
Great chatting with you! reach out any time.

Hey Mel! How're ya doin'? Recently, had not-so-great experience on a hike. ran into group of religious conservatives said something upset me. made me think how much work to do for LGBTQ rights. helpful to have people around me who accept and support me, so I know I'll be ok!
Hey Caroline, sorry about hike. sucks when people closed-minded. Strong support helps. finished another pottery project - want to see a pic?
Sure thing, Melanie! Can't wait see your pottery project happy you found something makes happy. Show me when can!
Here it is. Pretty proud of it! great experience. Thoughts? Image: a photo of a bowl with a colorful design on it
bowl is awesome, Mel! What gave you idea for all colors patterns?
Thanks, Caroline! I'm obsessed with those, made something to catch eye make people smile. Plus painting helps express feelings be creative. Each stroke carries part of me.
That's amazing! You put much effort passion into it. Your creativity shines. Seeing art can be source of self-expression growth inspiring. You're killing it!

Thanks, Caroline! Your words mean a lot. I've always felt strong connection to art, it's huge learning experience It's both a sanctuary and source of comfort. glad to have something brings me much happiness and fulfillment.
Glad found something makes you happy! Surrounding ourselves with things bring joy important. Life's too short to do anything else!
Agreed, Caroline. Life's tough worth it when have things make us happy.
Definitely, Mel! Finding happy moments clinging to them key. keeps us going even when life's hard. lucky to have people like you remind me.
same here Caroline. make life's struggles bearable.
Thanks Melanie means lot having you my corner Appreciate our friendship!
appreciate friendship, Caroline. You've always been there for me.
I'm always here for you, Mel! We had blast last year at Pride. supportive friends make everything worth it! Image: a photo of a group of people walking down a street with balloons
That was a blast! fun with whole gang! Wanna do family outing this summer?
Right, it was much fun! could do family outting, or plan something special for this summer, just us two? great chance to catch up explore nature! What do you think?
Sounds great Caroline plan something special!
Sounds great, Mel! make awesome memories!
Yeah, Caroline! start thinking what we can do.
Yeah, Mel! Life creating memories. Can't wait for trip!

Hi Melanie! Hope you're doing good. what I did this week? took first step towards becoming a mom - applied to adoption agencies! It big decision, but I'm ready to give love to a child. got help from adoption advice/assistance group I attended. It was great! Image: a photo of a sign with a picture of a guinea pig
Caroline, congrats! proud you for taking this step. How does it feel? have any pets?
Thanks, Mel! Exciting nerve-wracking. Parenting's big responsibility I do- Oscar, my guinea pig. He's been great. How are your pets?

Yeah's normal to be both excited and nervous with big decision thanks for asking, they're good- got another cat named Bailey too. Here pic of Oliver. show one of Oscar? Image: a photo of a black dog laying in the grass with a frisbee
He's so cute! What’s funniest thing Oliver's done? check out pic him eating parsley! Veggies his fave! Image: a photography of a guinea in a cage with hay and hay
Oliver's hilarious! hid bone in my slipper once! Cute, right? Almost as silly as I feed horse a carrot. Image: a photo of a person holding a carrot in front of a horse
That's so funny! I used to go horseback riding with my dad when was kid, go through fields, feeling wind. It was special.'ve always had love for horses!
Wow, sounds great agree, they're awesome. Here's photo of my horse painting did recently. Image: a photo of a horse painted on a wooden wall
